meta.name: Monitor DNS and domain security drift with DNSSEC, expiry checks and alerts

name: Domain & DNS Security Monitor - Advanced (WHOIS Expiry, DNSSEC, History & Drift Scoring)

parameters.content:
## 🛡️ Domain & DNS Security Monitor — Advanced Edition

Resolves live DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA), checks DNSSEC status, and tracks domain/certificate expiry — then diffs everything against an expected baseline to catch hijacks, mail-interception setups, and expiry-related outages before they happen.

### 🆕 What's new vs the basic version
- **Domain expiry monitoring** — flags domains approaching registration expiry (WHOIS-free, via RDAP)
- **DNSSEC posture check** — flags domains that lost DNSSEC signing since baseline
- **Weighted drift score** — combines record changes, expiry risk, and DNSSEC status into one 0-100 score instead of a single severity label
- **Change history** — persists a rolling log of diffs per domain using workflow static data, so repeated small changes (probing) are visible, not just isolated one-offs
- **Auto-baseline proposal** — low-risk confirmed-stable changes get a proposed baseline update logged for human sign-off, instead of alerting on the same accepted change every cycle

### 🎛️ Customization
Adjust the drift-score weights, which record types count as Critical vs Warning, the dedup wait duration, and the expiry warning window to match your risk tolerance.

## 1️⃣ Start & Configure Scan

Provides scheduled and manual entry points, then initializes the monitored domain list, each domain's expected-records baseline, allowed IP ranges, and expiry/DNSSEC policy.

## 2️⃣ Resolve DNS Records

Performs live DNS lookups for every monitored domain (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA) and checks DNSSEC signing status, attaching each domain's expected baseline for comparison.

## 3️⃣ Check Expiry

Queries the free public RDAP registry for each domain's registration expiry date and computes days-until-expiry, so lapses can be caught weeks ahead instead of causing an outage.

## 4️⃣ Detect Changes & Score Drift

Diffs current records against the expected baseline per record type, layers in expiry risk and DNSSEC posture, and computes a single weighted 0-100 drift score. Also appends this cycle's diff to a rolling per-domain change history (workflow static data) so repeated small probing changes are visible over time.

## 5️⃣ Classify, Auto-Baseline & Route

Turns the drift score and diff into a threat severity and a security-team-facing alert. Confirmed-stable, low-risk changes get a proposed baseline update logged for human sign-off instead of re-alerting every cycle on an already-accepted change. Routes Critical findings toward escalation and everything else toward standard logging.

## 🚨 Critical Escalation

Critical DNS changes (nameserver takeover, unexpected IP target, domain expiring imminently, or DNSSEC dropped) wait through a short dedup window before being packaged as an urgent security alert.
